name: Druid
source: ActiveWorkspace shared catalog enriched by audited RandomEncounters data

traits.name: Spellcasting
traits.description:
The druid is a 4th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 12, +4 to hit with spell attacks). It has the following druid spells prepared:

* Cantrips (at will): druidcraft, produce flame, shillelagh
* 1st level (4 slots): entangle, longstrider, speak with animals, thunderwave
* 2nd level (3 slots): animal messenger, barkskin

abilities.name: Quarterstaff
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +2 to hit (+4 to hit with shillelagh), reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage, or 6 (1d8 + 2) bludgeoning damage with shillelagh or if wielded with two hands.

homebrewAlignment.name: Neutral Adapter
homebrewAlignment.description: A true survivalist. Adjusts to any situation without strong ties or ideals. The embodiment of flexible neutrality.
